habitat: Attached marine sponge inspired teaching concept; not a coral
habitat_zh: 附着海生海绵灵感教学概念；非珊瑚
claim_scope: Named-taxon-inspired teaching art using basic recognizable form, not strict scientific reconstruction; no exact species/measurement/locomotion/coexistence claim.

reconstruction_notes.en: Original living inspired-by broad thin cupped shield based on ROM basic H.palmata morphology, with real inner/outer surfaces, small attachment base and restrained diverging radial relief. No perforated panel, tube-sponge reuse or microspicule/net/canal count claim. Nominal0.13m span, muted ochre palette and irregular rim layout are art choices; genus forms vary and this selected shield is not universal.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创活体inspired-by宽薄杯盾，依据ROM H.palmata基本形态，具真实内外表面、小附着基部及克制放射脊。不做漏孔平板，不复用管状海绵，不声称微骨针、网格或水孔计数准确。0.13米名义展幅、柔和赭色及不规则口缘为美术设定；属内形态多样，所选盾形不是全属普遍形态。

name.en: Hazelia open-shield sponge inspired teaching model
name.zh: Hazelia 开盾形海绵灵感教学模型

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish thin broad cup wall flares into an irregular shield with radiating fiber ridges in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
description.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以薄宽杯壁扩为不规则盾面，具放射纤维脊搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。
